summary: Lazard, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose its agreement to acquire all issued shares of Campbell Lutyens Holdings Limited, a private capital advisor. Total consideration is up to $660 million: $460 million initial (primarily in Lazard common stock at $46.50/share), $115 million deferred at two-year anniversary, and up to $85 million earn-out based on 2030 revenue targets. The transaction is expected to close with 100% ownership. Board supports the deal. Risk-arb focus: stock election mechanics, regulatory clearances, and earn-out achievability.
